instructor:
Dr. Bülend Ortaç is a genuinely supportive and dedicated instructor who fosters a positive and motivating learning atmosphere. His patience and attentiveness throughout the course clearly demonstrated both his deep knowledge of the subject and his commitment to student success. As the course progressed, my respect for him grew even stronger, both academically and personally.

The course content was highly instructive, particularly in helping me understand the foundational principles of microscopy and characterization techniques. As someone with a background in biology, I found the material on optical, fluorescence, and confocal microscopy to be both accessible and highly relevant to my field. The inclusion of laboratory sessions further enhanced the learning process by allowing us to directly apply theoretical knowledge through hands-on experience.

The only minor drawback was that the instructor's accent occasionally made it slightly difficult to grasp some points immediately. However, considering his academic background in France, this is entirely understandable and not something that detracted from the overall learning experience. His careful and thoughtful delivery more than compensated for this small issue.

Overall, I found this course to be both valuable and inspiring. It not only provided solid technical knowledge but also fostered a deeper scientific mindset. I would confidently recommend it to other students.

course: The strongest aspect of the course was its clear and well-structured introduction to a wide range of imaging and characterization techniques. Topics such as optical, fluorescence, and confocal microscopy were explained in a way that made them accessible even to students with a biology background, like myself. The course successfully bridged theoretical knowledge with practical relevance, and the inclusion of lab sessions greatly enhanced the learning experience by providing hands-on exposure. While the course was overall very informative, I believe it could have benefited from more frequent or in-depth laboratory sessions, given the practical nature of the subject. Additionally, some of the homework assignments felt unnecessary and did not directly contribute to a deeper understanding of the material.
